glosses: pair (two of the same or similar items that go together)
couple (two of the same or similar items)
two equal non-collinear forces; that is a force couple in Newtonian mechanics

examples.en: May I ask a few questions?
Could I get a few hours of sleep?

examples.text: Mi tío me dio un par de zapatos.
examples.en: My uncle gave me a pair of shoes.

examples.text: Te llamaré en un par de días.
examples.en: I'll call you in a couple of days.

examples.text: Éste es mi par de zapatos favorito.
examples.en: This is my favorite pair of shoes.
